name: Seed Junky | 1g Pre-Roll | Bora Bora
description:
Take a trip with Bora Bora, a tropical powerhouse bursting with bold, exotic flavor. Notes of Starburst candy, creamy fruit, bubblegum, and hibiscus flowers collide in a smooth, vacation worthy smoke. Sweet and floral on the inhale, gassy, rich and fruity on the exhale. Bora Bora delivers a layered, mouth coating experience that feels like paradise. With strong, lasting effects, this strain hits hard while keeping things breeze and fun. 

Tropical Burst x Malibu BX2
